spec.label: R-I084-3
spec.notes: Symptoms (the ~11-minute cascade of mechanism 3): at the parent fa977c3, pull_feeds sleeps `delay` after every discovered game except the last, whether or not download_game_feed made a request (it returns an existing file without calling urlopen). Node 1: two cached feeds, so time.sleep is called once and mock_sleep.assert_not_called() fails (line 195), after the two earlier assertions (two paths, urlopen not called) pass at the parent. Node 2: three games, 222 cached: urlopen is called twice (that assertion passes) and the parent sleeps after 111 and after the cached 222, so mock_sleep.call_count is 2, not 1 (line 215). Node 3: at the parent _refresh_season_data has no per-day memo, so the second same-day call pulls and rebuilds again and pull.call_count is 2 (line 31). Controls passing at both: next-day refresh, BTS_REFRESH_ALWAYS=1, failed build leaves no marker, stale marker without a parquet still refreshes. Static checks at fa977c3: pull_feeds(start_date, end_date, data_dir, delay=0.5); download_game_feed skips existing files; _refresh_season_data imports pull_feeds/build_season at call time; tests/conftest.py has no autouse fixtures. Environment: bts.model.predict imports lightgbm at module level, so the replay venv needs the model extra (it is present in the bts-w15 and bts-w15-evidence/ev venvs); without it both runs fail with ImportError. Each anchor occurs once at 0c8ed32 (test_pull.py lines 195 and 215, test_refresh_memo.py line 31).
